summary: This is a routine 6-K filing by Baosheng Media Group Holdings Ltd., a foreign private issuer, incorporating legal opinions (Cayman Islands and US counsel) and consents by reference into an existing Form F-3 shelf registration statement. The filing references a prospectus supplement dated July 13, 2026, for a $30M ordinary share purchase agreement with High West Partners LLC and $300K in commitment shares, but the 6-K itself only provides legal opinions and consents — no event triggering a special situation. This is an ordinary shelf takedown/at-the-market offering disclosure, not a standalone special event.
